snippet.title: Moo Who? – Official Gameplay Trailer | Moo to Survive!
snippet.description:
Can you sound convincing enough to survive?

Moo Who? is a multiplayer social stealth party game where real players hide among animals and use their microphones to imitate animal sounds.

Blend into the herd, act like an NPC, and moo, cluck, or squeal your way out of danger. Hunters must observe the animals, identify the real players, and eliminate them before time runs out.

🐄 Hide among NPC animals
🎙️ Use your microphone to mimic animal sounds
🔫 Observe, deceive, and survive
👥 Play with your friends online
😂 Create completely chaotic voice-chat moments

Wishlist Moo Who? on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4948000/Moo_Who/

Developed by SAT Productions.

#MooWho #IndieGame #MultiplayerGame
